Record Class TypefaceDecoration

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
net.phoenix.chromatic_codes.client.typeface.TypefaceDecoration
Record Components:
radius - thickness of an outline, or zero for depth
dx - total horizontal depth displacement
dy - total vertical depth displacement
public record TypefaceDecoration(float radius, float dx, float dy) extends Record
Describes the coverage behind a vector glyph in em units. The cache can reuse the same geometry at a given physical strike, independent of color, shadow and effect timing.
